name: Anileridine
aliases: Anileridina, Anileridinum, Leritine®, N-beta-(p-aminophenyl)ethylnormeperidine, N-beta-(P-Aminophenyl)ethylnormeperidine, N-β-(p-aminophenyl)ethylnormeperidine
summary: Anileridine (trade name: Leritine) is a synthetic analgesic drug and is a member of the piperidine class of analgesic agents developed by Merck & Co. in the 1950s. It differs from pethidine (meperidine) in that the N-methyl group of meperidine is replaced by an N-aminophenethyl group, which increases its analgesic activity.

pharmacology.text: It differs from pethidine (meperidine) in that the N-methyl group of meperidine is replaced by an N-aminophenethyl group, which increases its analgesic activity.

uses.text: Anileridine (trade name: Leritine) is a synthetic analgesic drug and is a member of the piperidine class of analgesic agents developed by Merck & Co. in the 1950s.

sideEffects.en: Like other opioids it causes drowsiness, nausea, constipation, itching and slowed breathing, and overdose can be fatal. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他鴉片類一樣，它會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕、搔癢與呼吸變慢，過量可能致命。規律使用會導致耐受性與依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他鸦片类一样，它会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘、搔痒与呼吸变慢，过量可能致命。规律使用会导致耐受性与依赖。

fact.en: Anileridine is pethidine with an aminophenethyl group in place of the methyl group on its nitrogen, a change that made it a stronger painkiller. Merck developed it in the 1950s and sold it as Leritine.
fact.zh: 阿尼利定是把配西汀氮原子上的甲基換成胺基苯乙基的產物，這個改動使它成為更強的止痛藥。默克在 1950 年代開發它，並以 Leritine 之名販售。
